name: vertical-video-engine
description: Production-ready 9:16 vertical video editing engine based on Remotion

scripts.render:full: node tools/check_approval.mjs && remotion render src/index.ts Main out/full_render.mp4
scripts.render:stems: node tools/check_approval.mjs && remotion render src/index.ts Scene01-Stems out/stems/scene_01_ui.mov --codec=prores --prores-profile=4444 --image-format=png && remotion render src/index.ts Scene02-Stems out/stems/scene_02_ui.mov --codec=prores --prores-profile=4444 --image-format=png && remotion render src/index.ts Scene03-Stems out/stems/scene_03_ui.mov --codec=prores --prores-profile=4444 --image-format=png
scripts.render:greenscreen: node tools/check_approval.mjs && remotion render src/index.ts GreenScreenOverlay out/greenscreen_overlay.mp4 --props="{\"chromaMode\":true}"
